description: GA overview of cluster-level and instance-level health for PMM HA, PostgreSQL/Patroni, ClickHouse, VictoriaMetrics, and HAProxy.

panels.description: PMM instances alive versus expected. Green means more than 2/3 of expected instances are alive, yellow means between 1/3 and 2/3 are alive (degraded), red means 1/3 or fewer are alive or none is discovered — matching the health shown on the PMM HA sidebar badge.

targets.expr: ((count(min by(exported_pod) (kube_pod_container_status_ready{exported_namespace="$namespace", exported_pod=~"${release}-${pmm_suffix_regex}"}) == 1) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum(kube_statefulset_replicas{exported_namespace="$namespace", statefulset="$release"}) or vector(0)), 1)) * 100

panels.title: PMM

panels.description: PostgreSQL instances alive versus expected. Green means more than 2/3 of expected instances are alive, yellow means between 1/3 and 2/3 are alive (degraded), and red means 1/3 or fewer are alive or none is discovered.

targets.expr: ((count(min by(exported_pod) (kube_pod_container_status_ready{exported_namespace="$namespace", exported_pod=~"${release}-pg-db-.*", exported_pod!~".*(${pg_exclude_regex}).*"}) == 1) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum(kube_statefulset_replicas{exported_namespace="$namespace", statefulset=~"${release}-pg-db-instance1-.*"}) or vector(0)), 1)) * 100

panels.description: Health percentage timeline for each service component. Shows % of pods running over time. 100% = all pods healthy (green), <100% = some pods down (red/yellow).

targets.expr:
(
  count(min by(exported_pod) (kube_pod_container_status_ready{exported_namespace="$namespace", exported_pod=~"${vm_suffix_regex}.*${release}.*", exported_pod!~".*($health_exclude_regex).*"}) == 1)
  /
  clamp_min(((sum(kube_statefulset_replicas{exported_namespace="$namespace", statefulset=~"${vm_suffix_regex}.*${release}.*"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{exported_namespace="$namespace", deployment=~"${vm_suffix_regex}.*${release}.*"}) or vector(0))), 1)
) * 100

(
  count(min by(exported_pod) (kube_pod_container_status_ready{exported_namespace="$namespace", exported_pod=~"$haproxy_pod_regex", exported_pod!~".*($health_exclude_regex).*"}) == 1)
  /
  clamp_min((sum(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{exported_namespace="$namespace", deployment=~"$haproxy_pod_regex"}) or vector(0)), 1)
) * 100
